verdict.rationale: Khoj's core interface is natural language. Users chat with it, find notes and documents 'using natural language', talk to it by voice, and can have it generate and run Python for analysis. Slash commands like /online, /notes and /dream steer its features. Community reports on weak search for non-English notes concern result quality, not the existence of the capability. missing for 10: evidence that product configuration (settings, agents, automations, data sources) can be managed via natural-language commands rather than the admin panel or UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language command reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Quickly find relevant notes and documents using natural language
You can chat with it about anything. It'll use files you shared with it to respond, when relevant.
You can talk to Khoj using your voice. Khoj will respond to your queries using the same models as the chat feature.
Khoj can generate and run simple Python code as well. This is useful if you want to have Khoj do some data analysis, generate plots and reports.
Use slash commands to quickly access Khoj features `/online`: Get responses from Khoj powered by online search.
